purpose: Human gold labels for Bishop professional-domain pre-filter (gate 1) and knowledge-base keep (gate 2). First labeled set. Replay after any profile, prompt, or threshold change.

precedent.why_this_shape: Spec §11.1: NL-profile pre-filter exists to generate labeled 0/1 data as the bootstrap for later cosine anchors. This eval set is that labeled data, plus a second label for enrichment-score / KB keep so we can calibrate both gates independently.
do_not: Do not edit items.json after freeze — new snapshots are a new eval_id
Do not change the profile and claim this set still measures v1.0.0
Do not treat enrichment_score as the pre-filter gold — they are different gates
Do not add open-text reason tags; use reasons[] from the closed vocab

gates.question: Given title + abstract only, should this pass the cheap binary gate?
If this reached the KB (or should have), should it stay as a first-class indexed item?
gates.system_proxy: enrichment_score with thresholds decided after this labeling pass

kb_values.keep: I would want this in the KB and to see it in search. Applied systems, architecture, shipping patterns, or durable skills.
kb_values.skim: Worth a glance or a summary card, not worth a full index slot. Adjacent, newsy, or one-off.
kb_values.drop: Should not have passed, or should be filtered before index. Academic internals, pretraining, weights-as-science, wrong domain.

reasons.applied_systems: What people or businesses are actually building — products, features, pipelines, ops.
reasons.architecture_tradeoffs: System design, constraints, failure modes, engineering decisions.
reasons.dev_skills: Dev-flow techniques, skills, agent/editor workflows I would reuse.
reasons.rag_retrieval: Retrieval, chunking, rerank, hybrid search, KB design.
reasons.agent_orchestration: Agents as systems: state machines, tools, memory, eval of agents — applied, not GUI-benchmark-only.
reasons.eval_observability: Eval harnesses, tracing, judges, production monitoring.
reasons.inference_serving: Serving, quantization, latency/cost — only if it informs shipping.
reasons.too_academic: Paper-coded experimental, novelty-first, not something I would implement.
reasons.wrong_domain: CV, robotics, market, clinical, hardware, or otherwise off-profile.
reasons.adjacent_interesting: Clever but not my lane; maybe a summary, not a keep.

label_record.reasons: list from reasons keys, at least one when labeled

acceptance_for_replay.then: Draft profile v1.1.0 from confusion + reason counts. Replay pre-filter offline on this frozen item set. Do not scrape a new live batch until replay metrics are recorded.

replay_protocol.input: item.title + item.abstract (pass split: use summary only if abstract missing — flag those)
